notation: Semantic contracts: what each component is, independent of its renderer. geometryFamily names a key in geometry-families.json; parts use part IDs; allowedParents use context names from composition.json. Manifests point here with contract pointers.

button.element: Host is the button (role=button, tabindex 0); no native button inside.
button.behavior: Enter and Space activate; type=submit requests submit of the owning form, type=reset resets it; disabled and loading block activation in the capture phase.

input.element: Host is form-associated; the editor is a contenteditable role=textbox inside the control part.
input.behavior: Single line: Enter requests submit, paste is flattened. type=password masks text and blocks copy and cut. Validates required, email, minlength and pattern after interaction.

select.element: Select-only combobox: focus stays on the trigger (role=combobox); the popup is a [popover] listbox holding the authored ui-option children.
select.behavior: APG select-only combobox keys, typeahead, outside press and blur close; selection commits on Enter, Tab or click.

field.element: Light-DOM wrapper with no role; the authored control stays a direct child and the field adds its parts as siblings.
field.behavior: Names its control: aria-labelledby (label text and unit ids) on a control whose host has the role, or the labelledby property of ui-input and ui-select; description ids likewise. A label press toggles a checkbox, switch or radio and focuses any other control.

field-grid.element: Light-DOM grid with no role: columns label | control | readout.
field-grid.behavior: None: each ui-field child is a subgrid row, so labels align at the widest one; other children (group headings) span every column.

fieldset.element: Host is the group (role=group) named by its legend part (aria-labelledby); no native fieldset or legend.
fieldset.behavior: disabled reaches every kit form control inside at any depth (their isDisabled reads it, like a native <fieldset disabled>) and sets data-disabled on the host and the legend; the legend names the group.

listbox.element: Host is the listbox (role=listbox) with aria-activedescendant; options are ui-option children.
listbox.behavior: Single select; selection follows focus; arrows by orientation, Home/End, typeahead.

option.element: One choice; the owning list sets role=option, id, aria-selected, data-selected, data-highlighted and data-disabled.
option.behavior: None of its own; value falls back to the label text.

checkbox.element: Host is the control (role=checkbox); children are the label; the indicator box sits in the leading slot.
checkbox.behavior: Space toggles; indeterminate shows mixed and clears on activation; required needs checked.

checkbox-group.element: Host is the group (role=group); its ui-checkbox children are the options, one of them optionally the parent; no parts of its own.
checkbox-group.behavior: Owns the value array: sets its checkboxes' checked state, a press adds or removes that value, fires change and input with { value, reason, event } (the checkboxes then fire none); a parent checkbox is checked / mixed / unchecked for all / some / none and sets every value; submits name=value per value; disabled reaches every checkbox.

radio.element: Host is the control (role=radio); radios group by name within their form or document.
radio.behavior: Arrows move and select within the group; roving tab stop on the checked (or first enabled) radio; required is group-wide.

radio-group.element: Host is the group (role=radiogroup); its ui-radio children are the options; no parts of its own.
radio-group.behavior: Owns the value: sets its radios' checked state, fires change and input with { value, reason, event } (the radios then fire none), submits one value under its name, validates required; the radios keep arrows and the roving tab stop within the group; disabled and readonly reach every radio.

switch.behavior: Space and Enter toggle; takes effect immediately.

range.behavior: Arrows step, Page Up/Down 10%, Home/End; pointer drag with capture; input while moving, change on commit.

badge.element: Short status or count; at least as wide as tall. Uses the construction pattern.

chip.element: Interactive label (role=button); selectable makes a toggle (aria-pressed); removable adds a trailing remove icon.
chip.behavior: Enter/Space activate; selectable toggles and fires change; Delete/Backspace or the remove icon fire a cancelable remove.

swatch.element: A color chip (role=img) unless a selectable palette owns it (role=option).
swatch.behavior: Invalid colors are ignored and marked; translucent colors sit on a checkerboard.

palette.element: A strip of ui-swatch children (role=group); with name or selectable a single-select listbox whose value is a swatch color.
palette.behavior: Selectable: arrows by orientation move and select.

swiper.element: Scroll-snap carousel (role=region, aria-roledescription=carousel); children become slides.
swiper.behavior: Native scrolling; paddles and dots go to slides; fires slidechange.

image.element: A framed image with a cover ratio, fit and position.
image.behavior: Lazy, async-decoded; failed images are marked; slideshow builds an inline swiper.

card.element: CSS-only container tag; padding="xs | sm | md | lg | xl" (2u…6u, md default) sets its level; radius equals its padding.

separator.element: Host is the rule (role=separator, aria-orientation); not focusable; no children.
separator.behavior: None: a static rule. orientation sets aria-orientation and data-orientation.

avatar.element: Host is the avatar frame (role=img with aria-label when alt or name is set); it owns an image part and a fallback part.
avatar.behavior: The image shows once it has loaded; until then, and after an error, the fallback shows (after delay ms): authored content, else the initials of name, else a user icon.

meter.element: Host is the meter (role=meter, aria-valuenow / min / max / valuetext, aria-labelledby its label part).
meter.behavior: None: a static measurement within a known range. The value text is formatNumber of the value (format) or, by default, the ratio as a percentage.

toggle.element: Host is the toggle button (role=button, aria-pressed, tabindex 0); no native button inside.
toggle.behavior: Click, Enter and Space flip pressed and fire a cancelable change { pressed, reason: none, event }; disabled blocks activation. No form value.

collapsible.element: Host holds a trigger (role=button, aria-expanded, aria-controls) and a panel that stays in the DOM, hidden while closed. Children become the panel unless a [data-part=panel] is authored; the label property fills a generated trigger.
collapsible.behavior: Enter, Space or a press on the trigger toggles the panel and fires a cancelable openchange ({ open, reason: 'trigger-press', event }); setting open fires nothing. The panel's height animates on the reveal intent in CSS.

accordion.element: Host stacks ui-collapsible children as its items (data-part=item); each item wraps its trigger in a heading part (role=heading, aria-level 3) and makes its panel a region labelled by the trigger.
accordion.behavior: The accordion owns the open state (value: the open item values; multiple allows several). A trigger press fires the item's openchange, then the accordion's cancelable change ({ value: string[], reason: 'trigger-press', event }); in single mode opening one item closes the others. Arrow keys (Up / Down, or Left / Right when horizontal), Home and End move focus between enabled triggers; every trigger stays in the tab order.

tabs.element: Host holds a tablist part (role=tablist) of tab parts (role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls) and an indicator, and tabpanel parts (one per tab, hidden while inactive). The preset generates the list from labelled panels.
tabs.behavior: Roving focus: the active tab is the tab stop; arrow keys (Left / Right mirrored in RTL, Up / Down when vertical), Home and End move focus between enabled tabs, wrapping. Enter, Space or a press activates (activate-on-focus: focus does); a user change fires a cancelable change ({ value, reason: 'none', event }). The indicator is placed by --active-tab-* variables set by script and slides on the toggle intent.

toast.element: Host is the toast region (role=region, a polite live region) holding a toast part per toast (role=dialog, alertdialog for priority high), each with a content part of title (h2), description (p), action and close (role=button) parts, drawn from a toast manager.
toast.behavior: Toasts come from a toast manager (add, update, close, promise). Each closes after its timeout (default 5000 ms; 0 keeps it); hovering or focusing the stack expands it and pauses every timer, as a hidden document does. A swipe in an allowed direction (default down, right), the close or Escape on a focused toast fire a cancelable openchange ({ open: false, id, toast, reason: 'swipe' | 'close-press' | 'escape-key', event }) and close it; F6 moves focus into the viewport and back. Toasts beyond the limit (3) are data-limited and inert.

form.element: Host is the form (role=form) and the form owner of the kit controls inside that have no native form; no native form inside or around it.
form.behavior: A submit (ui-button type=submit, Enter in a ui-input, requestSubmit()) validates every owned control, shows their errors and focuses the first invalid one; when all pass it fires formsubmit with { values, reason: 'none', event }. errors (by name) become the named controls' form errors, shown at once and cleared on their next change; validation-mode (onSubmit, onBlur, onChange) decides when their own errors show; reset() returns every control to its default.

scroll-area.element: Host is the area (no role); its viewport part scrolls natively (role=presentation, focusable while it overflows) and its scrollbar parts are pointer affordances (aria-hidden).
scroll-area.behavior: Measures the viewport on scroll and resize: Base UI's overflow and scrolling data-* on root, viewport, content and scrollbars, its CSS variables as custom properties; a scrollbar shows while its axis overflows and fades in on hover, scroll or keyboard focus; dragging a thumb scrolls 1:1 along its track, a press on the track centers the thumb under the pointer; keys scroll the focused viewport natively.

number-field.element: Host is form-associated; the label sits in the scrub area; the group holds the decrement and increment steppers (role=button, not tab stops) around the input, a contenteditable role=textbox with aria-roledescription "Number field".
number-field.behavior: The text is formatNumber of the value (format, locale) and is parsed back in the locale. Typing changes the value as soon as the text parses; blur or Enter commits: clamps to min / max (unless allow-out-of-range), snaps with snap-on-step and reformats. Arrow Up / Down step (Shift large-step, Alt small-step), Home / End go to min / max; the steppers step on press and repeat while held; dragging the scrub area steps per pixel-sensitivity px (data-scrubbing); the wheel steps with allow-wheel-scrub while focused and hovered. input fires on every change and change on every commit, with { value, reason, event } (Base UI onValueChange / onValueCommitted reasons).

otp-field.element: Host is form-associated and role=group; each input part is a contenteditable role=textbox holding one character (Character i of n); separator parts are role=separator.
otp-field.behavior: One value over length cells, kept contiguous. Typing overwrites the focused cell and moves to the next; a paste or autofill distributes from the focused cell; Backspace clears the focused cell or the one before, Delete the focused one; arrows (mirrored in RTL), Home and End move focus, which never lands past the first empty cell; the first empty cell is the only tab stop. validation-type (numeric, alpha, alphanumeric, none) filters characters, rejected ones fire valueinvalid; a complete value fires complete (auto-submit submits the form). input and change fire on every change with { value, reason, event } (Base UI reasons input-change, input-clear, input-paste, keyboard).

combobox.element: Editable combobox: focus stays in the input (a contenteditable role=combobox in the control row); typing filters the authored ui-option children in a [popover] listbox; aria-activedescendant points at the highlighted option. multiple shows the selected values as chips before the input.
combobox.behavior: Typing filters (contains, case- and accent-insensitive) and opens the popup; ArrowDown / ArrowUp open or move the highlight over visible enabled options; Enter or a press commits (single: closes, the input shows the label; multiple: toggles a chip and stays open); Escape closes; Tab and blur close without committing; Backspace in an empty multiple input removes the last chip. The clear button removes the value and text; the trigger toggles the popup. Events carry Base UI details: change / input { value, reason, event }, inputvaluechange { value, reason, event }, openchange { open, reason, event } (cancelable).

autocomplete.element: Free text with suggestions: focus stays in the input (a contenteditable role=combobox in the control row, aria-autocomplete = mode); the value is its text; the authored ui-option children are suggestions in a [popover] listbox; aria-activedescendant points at the highlighted one.
autocomplete.behavior: Typing is the value and opens the popup; mode list filters the suggestions (contains, case- and accent-insensitive), both also completes inline (the rest of the first suggestion that starts with the text, selected), inline completes without filtering, none does neither. ArrowDown / ArrowUp move the highlight (inline modes write it into the input); Enter or a press writes a suggestion and closes; Enter with no highlight closes and submits the form; Escape closes. Events: input { value, reason, event } on every change, change on a commit, the clear button or blur, openchange { open, reason, event } (cancelable).
